Kabhi sote sote aisa laga, ki aap kahin se gir rahe ho... aur ekdum se jhatka lag gaya?
Isse kehte hain hypnic jerk. Aur ye bahut common hai, zyaadatar log ise kabhi na kabhi feel karte hain.
Jab aap neend mein jaate ho, toh aapki muscles dheeli padne lagti hain.
Ek theory kehti hai, ki dimaag isse confuse ho jaata hai, aur sochta hai ki aap gir rahe ho!
Toh bachane ke liye, wo poori body ko ek jhatke mein jaga deta hai.
Zyaada chai coffee, stress, ya thakaan ho, toh ye jhatke aur badh jaate hain.
Par ghabraao mat, ye bilkul normal hai. Aisi aur mazedaar baaton ke liye, follow karo!
